title: When Covariates Mask Pre-Trends
abstract: arXiv:2611.03079v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Honest difference-in-differences methods judge how far parallel trends may fail after treatment by how far it failed before treatment, as shown by placebo estimates. When the design adjusts for covariates, the placebo estimates are adjusted too. We show that this benchmark is valid only if the covariates are measured before the earliest placebo window. A covariate measured later already reflects shocks to the outcome during the placebo period, so adjusting for it hides part of the pre-trend. The placebos then look flatter than the true trend and the resulting confidence sets are too narrow. When the covariate is also observed at an early date, the distortion can be estimated and tested. Of 90 recent published studies that adjust for time-varying covariates, 77 measure at least one covariate too late.

translated_title: 当协变量掩盖了前趋势
translated_abstract: 稳健的（诚实的）双重差分方法通过安慰剂估计来衡量处理前平行趋势背离的程度，以此判断处理后平行趋势可能背离的程度。当研究设计对协变量进行调整（控制）时，安慰剂估计也会随之进行协变量调整。我们证明，这一基准只有在协变量在最早的安慰剂窗口之前测量时才有效。较晚测量的协变量本身已经反映了安慰剂期内结果变量所受到的冲击，因此对它进行调整会掩盖部分前趋势。这会使安慰剂估计看起来比真实趋势更平坦，导致所得到的置信集过窄。当协变量在早期时点也有观测时，这种失真可以被估计和检验。在90篇近期采用时变协变量进行调整的已发表研究中，有77篇至少有一个协变量的测量时间过晚。
tldr: 该研究揭示：双重差分设计中若协变量的测量时间晚于最早的安慰剂窗口，对其进行调整会掩盖部分前趋势，使安慰剂检验显得过于平坦、置信区间过窄；论文提出了估计与检验该失真的方法，并发现90篇已发表研究中有77篇存在协变量测量过晚的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that adjusting for covariates measured after the earliest placebo window masks part of the pre-trend in difference-in-differences designs, making placebo estimates look flatter and confidence sets too narrow; it proposes methods to estimate and test this distortion, finding that 77 of 90 published studies measure at least one covariate too late.
